turns.question: How many leads did every 100 euros of social ad spend get us in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for leads per 100 euros of spend, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are cost per lead and the leads and ad spend behind it: for the social channel in September 2026 (1 to 30 September), there were 40 leads on EUR 2,100.00 of ad spend, a cost per lead of EUR 52.50. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
